line: Pramukh Swami Maharaj in the UK: The turn of the millennium
whatsapp: On this day in 2000, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was in the UK. The turn of the millennium. line: For the opening of the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Islington
card: For the opening of the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan
whatsapp: On this day in 1970, Yogiji Maharaj was in London. For the opening of the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Islington, London, Yogiji Maharaj graced the land of UK from 23 May to 7 July 1970 for 46 days and left lasting memories for countless haribhaktas and built the foundation for the development of satsang in UK-Europe. 23 May 1970 was also the first time that Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Mahant Swami Maharaj were stepping foot in the west. Click on the below link for smruti of this historic day through archive videos, eyewitness interviews, audios of telephone conversations, and the unique recording from the 'palen'.

line: After 14 days in London
whatsapp: On this day in 1970, Yogiji Maharaj was in Leicester, UK. After 14 days in London, Yogiji Maharaj departed from London on 6 June to give labh to the upcountry haribhaktas despite his advanced age and fragile health. Pramukh Swami also conducted over 20 padharamanis on that day in Leicester.

line: On Saturday 16 July 1977
whatsapp: On this day in 1977, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was in Ashton-under-Lyne. On Saturday 16 July 1977, almost six years after the Satsang Mandal in Manchester had begun with a handful of devotees, His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj opened a small mandir in Ashton-under-Lyne. The murtis that Yogiji Maharaj had originally installed in Islington in 1970 were re-installed at a small premises in Cowhill Lane following the yagna ceremony at the Indian Association Hall. [The murtis were subsequently moved to larger premises after the property in Russell Street was acquired in 1980.]

line: Satsang had been established in Leicester following Yogiji Maharaj’s visit in 1970
card: Satsang had been established in Leicester
whatsapp: On this day in 1977, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was in the UK. Satsang had been established in Leicester following Yogiji Maharaj’s visit in 1970, and further consolidated by Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s vicharan in 1974. The local devotees were inspired by Swamishri to search for a place to worship. On the morning of Sunday 24 July 1977, Swamishri joined 70 devotees in the yagna ceremony, before consecrating the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj at the new mandir in Leicester on 148 Doncaster Road, the third Akshar-Purushottam mandir in the UK.

line: On Saturday 30 July (Adhik Shravan sud Punam)

whatsapp: On this day in 1977, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was in Wellingborough, UK. On Saturday 30 July (Adhik Shravan sud Punam), Pramukh Swami Maharaj inaugurated a new mandir in Wellingborough, the third BAPS Swaminarayan mandir to be consecrated in a short span of 15 days. The pictorial murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Radha-Krishna Bhagwan and the Guru Parampara were part of a grand procession through the streets of Wellingborough. Hundreds of devotees gathered to make history as the first Hindu mandir in Wellingborough was opened at humble premises on Mill Road.

line: Pramukh Swami Maharaj inaugurates BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in London
card: Pramukh Swami Maharaj inaugurates BAPS Shri
whatsapp: On this day in 1995, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was in London, UK. Pramukh Swami Maharaj inaugurates BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in London, the first traditional Hindu temple in the west. It had been 25 years since Yogiji Maharaj had declared his divine wish for a traditional mandir in London, spoken at the time of the opening of the small mandir in Islington in June 1970. It had been 23 years since Pramukh Swami Maharaj himself had proclaimed a majestic vision for London, in 1972, in Piplana.
story: Pramukh Swami Maharaj inaugurates BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in London, the first traditional Hindu temple in the west. It had been 25 years since Yogiji Maharaj had declared his divine wish for a traditional mandir in London, spoken at the time of the opening of the small mandir in Islington in June 1970. line: An all-day ‘chhavani’ (spiritual camp of discourses) on the fundamental principles of Akshar-Purushottam
whatsapp: On this day in 2017, Mahant Swami Maharaj was in the UK. An all-day ‘chhavani’ (spiritual camp of discourses) on the fundamental principles of Akshar-Purushottam Darshan (upasana) was held in the presence of Mahant Swami Maharaj and senior swamis at BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, London. Mahant Swami Maharaj had expressed his wish for this special programme to be organised and personally encouraged everyone to attend. He drew upon the four-month chhavani that had been held in Vartal, India, during the time of Gunatitanand Swami and gave his blessings for a similar day of spiritual enrichment in London.

line: After learning in one of the recent discourses of the Shakotsav celebrated 170 years previously in Loya
card: After learning in one of the recent discourses
whatsapp: On this day in 1990, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was in London. After learning in one of the recent discourses of the Shakotsav celebrated 170 years previously in Loya by Bhagwan Swaminarayan, the devotees of London made a sankalp that such a shakotsav be celebrated in London as well. After due preparations were made, Param Pujya Swamishri went to the Mandir kitchen area around 4.50pm and personally conducted the shak vaghar in three big utensils in which a total of 10 maunds (200kg) of aubergines were prepared. After offering the final product to Harikrishna Maharaj, the devotees partook of this as prasad following the evening sabha.
